title: How to buy a car with Amazon Autos
summary: Amazon Autos lets you browse, compare, finance, and buy new, used, and certified pre-owned vehicles—all online.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Amazon Autos works with over 1,000 participating dealers in more than 130 U.S. cities, with more cities being added regularly.


- Shop thousands of new, used, and certified pre-owned vehicles online with upfront pricing, then pick up at a local dealership.


- Every purchase of a used or certified pre-owned vehicle comes with a minimum 3-day/300-mile return policy.*


---


What if buying a car were as straightforward as shopping on Amazon?


That's the idea behind


[Amazon Autos](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-autos-buy-car-online) —a service that lets you browse thousands of new, used, or certified pre-owned (CPO) vehicles from trusted dealers in your area, compare personalized financing options, and lock in a price, all from your phone or laptop.


[How to use Amazon's price history feature](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-check-amazon-price-history)


Amazon’s agentic AI assistant for shopping now shows customers a full year of price history on products in the U.S., UK, and India.


Here is everything you need to know about Amazon Autos.


## Can you buy a car through Amazon?


Yes. Through Amazon Autos, you can browse and compare vehicles, secure financing, and complete most of the paperwork online before picking up at your local dealership.


Since launching in December 2024 with new Hyundai vehicles, Amazon Autos has expanded to include new, used, and CPO inventory from dealers across the country, including Chevrolet, Jeep, Kia, Subaru, and additional brands from franchised dealers. Today, Amazon Autos works with over 1,000 participating dealers spanning more than 130 cities across the United States.


Amazon Autos isn't a direct-to-consumer car store. It connects you with U.S.-based dealerships—you're still buying from a real dealer with real expertise, but Amazon powers the digital storefront that makes the process simpler, faster, and more transparent.


## How does buying a car with Amazon Autos work?


The process works following these straightforward steps:


- Browse and compare:


Search vehicles listed within 75 miles of your zip code. Filter by make, model, price, features, and more.


- Choose your purchase type:


Decide whether you want to finance, lease, or pay in full.


- Trade-in:


Enter the details of your existing vehicle to see its estimated trade-in value.


- Add protection products:


Select optional warranty or protection plans.


- Lease, finance, or pay in full:


Compare personalized offers from multiple lending partners and choose the one that fits your budget.


- Place a deposit:


Lock in your vehicle and schedule your pickup.


- Pick up your car:


Visit the dealership within 3 days. Finance contracts are sent to you before pickup, and any paperwork requiring a physical signature can be completed when you arrive.


You can start and complete most of the process from your couch, on your own schedule. No need to spend hours at a dealership negotiating.


## What vehicles are available on Amazon Autos?


Amazon Autos offers thousands of vehicles across three categories:


- New vehicles


from Hyundai, Kia, Subaru, Mazda, Chevrolet, GMC, Cadillac, Jeep, Dodge, and Ram, with more brands being added.


- CPO vehicles


from Hyundai and


[Ford](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-autos-buy-cars-online-ford) (Ford Blue Advantage).


- Used vehicles


including inventory from Hertz and hundreds of dealers across 130 U.S. cities spanning various makes, models, and vehicle types.


If multiple dealers are within range of your zip code, you can choose which one you'd like to work with. Listings are shown from dealers within 75 miles of your location.


[Amazon adds certified pre-owned Ford vehicles for customers to browse, finance, and purchase online](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-autos-buy-cars-online-ford)


Customers can now browse, finance, and purchase Ford Blue Advantage certified pre-owned vehicles from participating Ford dealers on Amazon Autos.


## How much does a car cost on Amazon Autos?


Pricing is upfront and transparent. Amazon does not charge customers any transaction fees or commissions. Every vehicle listed on Amazon Autos has an up-front price set by the dealer. There's no back-and-forth negotiation, no hidden fees, and no surprises at the end.


Costs are fully itemized so you can see exactly what you're paying for—including the vehicle price, taxes, fees, and any protection products you choose to add.


[Meet Alexa for Shopping, your personalized, agentic AI assistant on Amazon](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/alexa-for-shopping-ai-assistant)


Amazon brings together Rufus and Alexa+ to create ‘Alexa for Shopping’ on the Amazon Shopping app and website.


## How do you finance a car on Amazon Autos?


Amazon Autos lets you see and compare multiple personalized financing offers in one place—before you ever set foot in a dealership.


Each offer comes with clear terms and itemized costs, so you can compare them and choose the option that best fits your budget. You can also choose to lease or pay in full if financing isn't right for you.


## Can you trade in or sell your car on Amazon Autos?


Customers can trade in their current vehicle if they're purchasing a vehicle through Amazon Autos. They can input the details of their current vehicle to get a valuation.


## How do you pick up a car bought on Amazon Autos?


After you place your deposit and complete the online paperwork, you'll schedule a pickup at the dealership—typically within 3 days of placing your order.


Here's what to expect:


- Before pickup:


The dealer sends you e-contracts to review and sign digitally.


- At pickup:


You'll complete any remaining paperwork that requires a physical signature, then drive away in your new car.


Dealerships also offer test drives, so you can get behind the wheel before finalizing your decision.


## What is Amazon Autos’ return policy?


Every used or CPO vehicle purchased through Amazon Autos comes with a 3-day/300-mile return policy.* That means if you change your mind within three days or 300 miles of driving—whichever comes first—you can return the vehicle.


This gives you the freedom to make a decision with an added layer of confidence backed by Amazon.


## Why buy a car with Amazon Autos?


Amazon Autos is designed to give you confidence in your purchase. Here's how:


- Trusted dealers


: Amazon Autos works with U.S.-based dealerships that meet its quality and customer service standards.


- Vehicle history reports:


Comprehensive Vehicle History Reports are available for used and CPO listings, so you can review a vehicle's background before buying.


- Warranty coverage:


Used and CPO vehicles come with a minimum 30-day/1,000-mile Limited Warranty. New vehicles carry the manufacturer's warranty.


- Transparent pricing:


No hidden fees or last-minute add-ons.


- Return policy (for used and CPO vehicles):


A minimum 3-day/300-mile return policy provides a safety net.*


## Where is Amazon Autos available?


Amazon Autos is currently available in more than 130 U.S. cities, including Los Angeles, Dallas, Houston, and Seattle—with more locations planned in the future.


[Amazon’s commitment to low prices every day](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-orders-savings-discounts-shopping)


Amazon offers the lowest prices every day across the widest selection of products—plus extra savings for Prime members.


To check availability in your area, visit


[Amazon Autos.](https://www.amazon.com/Amazon-Autos/b?ie=UTF8&node=10677469011) Vehicles are shown from dealers within 75 miles of your location.


## How is buying a car with Amazon Autos different from a dealership?


Buying through Amazon Autos still involves a real dealership, but think of it this way:


Amazon Autos gives you the research, comparison, and financing tools to make your decision at home—then you test drive and pick up the car when you're ready. Less time at the dealership, more confidence in your choice.


Next, learn more about


[how to use Alexa for Shopping to compare products, check price history, auto-buy items at target prices, and more](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-use-amazon-shopping-ai-assistant) .


Amazon Autos is available in select U.S. markets only. Inventory varies by location.


*Return policy may vary in certain states.
